definition_en: The ability to create, distribute, and manage content and campaigns that promote products, services, or ideas to target audiences.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk menghasilkan, mengedar dan mengurus kandungan serta kempen yang mempromosikan produk, perkhidmatan atau idea kepada khalayak sasaran.
typical_tasks_en:
• Create a social media campaign to attract young mothers to the parenting workshop.
• Write a press release announcing the new sustainability initiative.
• Analyse engagement rates across Instagram and TikTok posts.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Cipta kempen media sosial untuk menarik ibu muda ke bengkel keibubapaan.
• Tulis siaran akhbar mengumumkan inisiatif kemampanan baharu.
• Analisis kadar penglibatan merentasi siaran Instagram dan TikTok.
inclusion_rules:
• The task involves creating promotional or brand content
• The task requires managing advertising or media campaigns
• The task involves analysing audience engagement or market trends
• The task requires managing social media or public relations
• The task involves positioning products or services in the market
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only internal communication without promotion
• The user shares information without any marketing intent
• The task requires no understanding of audience or market
• The user is simply posting content without strategic purpose
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task shares information internally with no promotional intent or audience targeting.

confusions.boundary_rule: Marketing uses creative ideas strategically to reach audiences.
confusions.example_task: Develop a creative campaign to launch the new product.

confusions.boundary_rule: Marketing attracts customers. Service supports existing customers.
confusions.example_task: Create a campaign to win back former customers.
confusions.expected_labels: Marketing and media; Service orientation and customer service

confusions.boundary_rule: Marketing focuses on message and reach. Design focuses on user experience.
confusions.example_task: Design promotional materials that are also accessible.
confusions.expected_labels: Marketing and media; Design and user experience
